data.text: The CLI command itself is just a thin wrapper; the behavior lives in `agentcli/models.go`, so I’m reading that path next. I also found `internal/discoverycache` already has multiprocess tests, which is a good sign that the missing proof may be a CLI-level test harness rather than new runtime logic.

I’ve confirmed the refresh path goes through `modelregistry.AssembleWithOptions` and `discoverycache.Cache`, so cross-process dedupe should be observable from the CLI without touching runtime code. The next step is to see whether there’s already a subprocess harness I can reuse for a deterministic counting fake, so the new test stays stable instead of depending on an ad hoc live server.
